rationale: Humanizer can benefit from bounded advisory selection when several already eligible rewrite candidates or admitted transformation strategies are available. Decision Fabric may rank or select only within a policy-preauthorized candidate set; protected-content validation, semantic/factual preservation gates, human acceptance, permissions, provider/model admission, resource admission and release promotion remain outside Decision Fabric.

decision_points.purpose: Rank or select among already-generated rewrite candidates that have passed deterministic eligibility and preservation prechecks.
